mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above CPIAUCSL 300 (current level) signals a need for monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) signal a restrictive monetary policy environment, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0%, it signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When month-over-month employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals a strong labor market, supporting economic growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 101.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 665000 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400, it signals strong consumer demand and housing market activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 665000 and HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market, supporting economic growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
